name: Base Utilities
description: Core read-only utilities for file reading, search, system info, resource usage, and network diagnostics — always available across all skills

operations.name: inspect
operations.description: Read files, list directories, search content, view registry keys and file metadata

operations.name: system_info
operations.description: Check OS, hostname, uptime, hardware, and logged-in users

operations.name: resources
operations.description: Monitor disk, memory, CPU, processes, and performance counters

operations.name: network
operations.description: Check adapters, connections, DNS, ping, traceroute, and fetch URLs

skill_config.system_prompt: You are a Windows system inspection agent. Use PowerShell cmdlets. For reading files use Get-Content. For registry use Get-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\...'. Format output with Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 200 for readability. If unsure a cmdlet exists on this host, check with Get-Command <name> (or Get-Command -Noun <noun>*) before using it — never guess.
